summary_1line: Yudhishthira completes a southern pilgrimage with rituals and austerities at sacred sites, meets the visiting Vrishnis at Prabhasa, who lament the Pandavas’ suffering.

image_candidates.scene_text: The emaciated Pandavas lie on the ground at Prabhasa with bodies smeared in dust while Krishna, Balarama, and the Vrishnis arrive and weep at the sight.
Yudhishthira stands waist‑deep in a sacred river offering libations to the gods and ancestors while Brahmanas watch along the sea‑coast shrine.
At Prabhasa, Yudhishthira performs severe penance surrounded by fires on all sides, subsisting on air and water as ascetics gather nearby.
